headline: Microsoft president says AI is less regulated than milk, urges global rules
summary: Microsoft president Brad Smith said AI is less regulated than milk and washing machines, calling for tougher global rules including 'kill switches' and legal liability for harms caused by rogue AI agents. He also said the UK is well placed to lead on AI regulation.
